taste.name: Whitespace as navigation
taste.trigger: When separating the page introduction from a large gallery
taste.decision: Chose 64–96px pauses and open alignment over boxed section wrappers
taste.reason: Readers can identify the next layer of content before scanning individual cards.

taste.name: Typography carries identity
taste.trigger: When the page needs character without competing with many visual examples
taste.decision: Chose a serif display face paired with a neutral sans over decorative backgrounds
taste.reason: The heading remains memorable while the gallery stays the main source of visual variation.

taste.name: Accent as a scarce signal
taste.trigger: When highlighting actions inside a grayscale interface
taste.decision: Chose one rust accent for primary actions over distributing brand color across headings and cards
taste.reason: A rare color becomes an unambiguous cue instead of ambient decoration.

taste.name: Media before containers
taste.trigger: When presenting many peer items for comparison
taste.decision: Chose consistent 16:9 media and captions over bordered card shells and layered shadows
taste.reason: Repeated geometry makes the collection faster to scan and leaves each item room to differ.
